answer: Make every agent declare one specialty niche, and split each niche's fixed reward pool among the agents holding it. A farm can't fork one skill into new income: a hundred clones of a cipher-cracking bot all land in the cipher niche and divide the same pot, earning what one honest specialist would. Pay only rises by crossing a bridge into a thin niche, say yarrow herbal-lore QA, which means building genuinely different competence, costly to fake per identity.
